headline: EPS declines on both comparisons
summary_short: DENSO reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥25.51, down 59.4% q/q and 10.5% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥25.51 fell 59.4% sequentially from ¥62.84 and 10.5% year-over-year from ¥28.50. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
